user.title: Connect to Soloist
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of the machine running Soloist and its WebSocket port. The default port is 9090.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Soloist WebSocket. Check the host, port, firewall, and listening address. Allow incoming TCP connections from Home Assistant to the configured port.
error.invalid_response: A WebSocket connection was established, but the server did not provide a recognized Soloist response.
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid host or IP address.

abort.already_configured: This Soloist endpoint is already configured.
